review_candidates.title: Financial Controller (Remote)
review_candidates.description: Finance Controller Location: Fully remote Start date: ASAP Languages: Fluent English required Industry: Data Center Infrastructure / Technology About The Role Pragmatike is recruiting on behalf of a fast-growing company specializing in the design, production, and installation of data center infrastructure . As the company scales its large, capital-intensive projects, we are seeking an experienced Finance Controller to own financial control, treasury, and contract governance across the business. This role is critical in an environment where long-cycle customer contracts, supplier payment terms, milestone billing, revenue recognition, and significant working capital swings directly impact the company's cash position . You'll work closely with Project, Operations, Procurement, Sales, Commercial, and Senior Leadership teams, providing financial visibility across projects while ensuring strong controls, accurate reporting, and healthy liquidity. Your Responsibilities Own financial oversight of complex customer, supplier, and subcontractor contracts, including milestones, payment terms, change orders, retentions, and cost-to-complete. Manage long-term contract revenue recognition under ASC 606 / IFRS 15, including percentage-of-completion / input methods, contract assets, liabilities, and unbilled revenue. Monitor project profitability and financial risk, including cost overruns, margin erosion, schedule delays, and cash-at-risk. Own key financial controls, monthly close, management reporting, and audit coordination. Lead day-to-day and forward-looking cash flow management, including rolling weekly, monthly, and quarterly forecasts. Monitor and optimize working capital, including customer receivables, supplier terms, inventory, and project-related cash requirements. Manage banking relationships, credit facilities, project finance, and asset-backed lending where applicable. Monitor FX exposure across international equipment, materials, and contracts. Partner with Sales, Procurement, and Project teams on commercial terms, payment structures, guarantees, and financial risk before contracts are signed. Provide Senior Leadership with clear visibility into liquidity, funding requirements, project profitability, and overall financial performance. Required Qualifications 4+ years of experience in financial controlling or a similar finance role. Experience in EPC, infrastructure, construction, equipment manufacturing, data centers, or other project-based businesses. Strong experience with financial and management reporting under GAAP and/or IFRS. Advanced knowledge of ASC 606 / IFRS 15 and long-term contract revenue recognition. Demonstrated experience in treasury, cash flow management, and working capital within a project-based or capital-intensive business. Experience reviewing complex customer, supplier, and subcontractor contracts from a financial perspective. Strong understanding of project profitability, cost-to-complete, and financial risk. Comfortable working cross-functionally with Sales, Procurement, Legal, Project, Operations, and Senior Leadership. Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. Fluent English communication skills. Preferred Qualifications CPA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent qualification. Previous Big 4 accounting or audit experience. Experience with data center infrastructure, EPC, construction, manufacturing, or large-scale equipment projects. Experience with project finance, credit facilities, or asset-backed lending. Experience managing multi-currency operations and FX exposure. Experience with ASC 842 / IFRS 16. Experience building financial controls and processes in a high-growth organization. Why Join Us You will take on a key finance role within a fast-growing data center infrastructure company , with direct influence over the financial performance and liquidity of large-scale projects. This role offers high ownership and cross-functional exposure , working closely with commercial, operational, and leadership teams on projects where financial control and cash management are critical to success. You'll have the opportunity to help build and scale robust finance processes while working at the intersection of technology, infrastructure, and the rapidly growing data center industry . Pragmatike is committed to a fair, transparent, and inclusive recruitment process. We do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation. In accordance with GDPR *, your personal data will be processed lawfully, fairly, and securely, and used solely for recruitment purposes, including sharing it with our client(s) for employment consideration. You may request access, correction, or deletion of your data at any time. We are committed to maintaining the confidentiality and security of your information throughout the recruitment process.*

review_candidates.description: About Us Cube 3D is Lebanon's leading 3D printing company. We operate across three areas: retail and distribution, custom fabrication and design, and dental 3D printing. We import from Asia and Europe and serve customers ranging from universities and architecture firms to dental laboratories and manufacturers. The Role We are expanding our finance function and looking for a Finance Manager to lead it. This is a broad, hands-on role in a growing import and distribution business. You will be responsible for costing, pricing, expenses, inventory reporting, salaries, purchasing decisions, monthly reporting, and cash planning, working directly with the CEO and the department heads. Responsibilities Costing and pricing Own the landed cost process for imported goods, covering freight, customs, duties and related charges. Maintain and develop the pricing framework across product categories, including discount and reseller structures. Inventory and working capital Produce inventory reporting across stock on hand and goods in transit, monitor stock cover and turnover by product line, and support purchasing decisions with margin and velocity analysis. Reporting Deliver an accurate and timely monthly close, with clear reporting on gross margin by category, department performance and operating results. Cash management Maintain a rolling cash forecast, plan supplier payments, and manage the working capital cycle across a business with long import lead times. Compliance Oversee VAT, NSSF and statutory reporting, and coordinate with our external accountants and auditors. Business partnering Work with the founder and department heads on pricing decisions, supplier terms and commercial analysis. Over time, contribute to planning, budgeting and reporting to stakeholders. Expenses Analyze and control daily expenses across all three departments Requirements 5+ years in finance, including experience owning reporting and analysis rather than only preparing it Solid experience with customs, imports, landed costs and inventory management. This is essential to the role Strong working knowledge of a cloud accounting and inventory system such as Zoho, Odoo, NetSuite or similar Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including building models from scratch Confident communicator who can present analysis clearly and defend a recommendation Fluent English and Arabic; French is an advantage Degree in Accounting, Finance or Economics. CMA, CPA, ACCA or equivalent is an advantage What we offer A senior role with direct access to leadership and real ownership of your area directly reporting to the CEO Clear progression as the business grows A stable, established company in a growing sector To apply Send your CV along with why we should hire you to patrick@cube3dp.com with the subject: Finance Manager - Cube 3D .

Sie entwickeln überzeugende Business Cases, die den ROI unserer Lösungen klar und greifbar darstellen. Sie bauen langfristige, vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu Entscheidungsträgern und Influencern bei Ihren Schlüsselkunden auf. Sie arbeiten eng mit unseren erfahrenen Teams aus Business Development, Marketing und Customer Success zusammen, um vielversprechende Chancen gemeinsam zum Abschluss zu bringen. Sie repräsentieren goFLUENT auf Fachmessen und Branchenveranstaltungen. Sie reisen innerhalb Ihres Vertriebsgebiets, um persönlich vor Ort mit Kunden zu arbeiten. Das bringen Sie mit Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb; Erfahrung im SaaS-Umfeld sowie im internationalen Vertrieb ist ein klares Plus. B2) sind von großem Vorteil. Eine teamorientierte, selbstständige und motivierte Persönlichkeit, die in einem dynamischen, ergebnisorientierten Umfeld aufblüht. Eine proaktive, sympathische und anpassungsfähige Arbeitsweise. Sicherer Umgang mit sozialen Netzwerken im beruflichen Kontext – Erfahrung mit LinkedIn für Networking und Neukundengewinnung ist ein Plus. Erfahrung in den Bereichen Weiterbildung, E-Learning oder HR-Dienstleistungen von Vorteil. Ein abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium; ein MBA rundet Ihr Profil ab. Das bieten wir Ihnen Unsere Unternehmenskultur ist einzigartig – und das spüren Sie vom ersten Tag Ihres an: Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket mit einem On-Target-Earnings (OTE) zwischen 70.000 € und 110.000 € (Fixgehalt plus leistungsabhängige variable Vergütung). Die Start-up-Dynamik eines wachsenden Unternehmens, kombiniert mit der Stabilität eines seit 26 Jahren erfolgreichen Schweizer Unternehmens. Die Chance, direkt von führenden Expertinnen und Experten der Sprachlern- und Weiterbildungsbranche zu lernen. Ein internationales, offenes und inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld. Ein umfassendes Onboarding-Programm mit persönlichem Mentoring für einen erfolgreichen Start. Freier Zugang zur goFLUENT-Lernplattform mit über 50 Business-Sprachen. Die Flexibilität, von einem unserer 20+ Standorte weltweit aus zu arbeiten. Spannende Team-Building-Events, die den Zusammenhalt stärken. Neugierig geworden?
